assessment.reason: The under at plus money has a projected mean below the line, and the case appears to survive a plausible role bump. No specific blocker was identified, though the edge is unvalidated and the gap from the market is large.
assessment.model_case: The projected mean is about 1.30 shots on 13.9 minutes, with a median of one. The weakness is that the shrunk production rate and modest ice-time projection do most of the work. Even so, scaling the means up by a tenth leaves the under above break-even.
assessment.price_case: This is the main 1.5 line at +110, which needs slightly under even odds to break even. The model's fair price is about -170. The large gap from the market deserves scrutiny, since the book's near-even pricing implies a higher shot expectation. Only two books cover this market.
assessment.context_case: Suzuki's listed absence could reshuffle Montréal's forward lines. No source addresses Anderson's role, so his context is unverified. Absence from the injury table does not establish his health.

qualitative_review.countercase: The market may be pricing Anderson's shot volume higher than a 13.9-minute, shrunk-rate projection allows. If Suzuki's absence moves him into a bigger even-strength or power-play role, his attempts could rise. A single high-volume game clears 1.5 easily.
